title: Power-Grid Structure Exploration with Unified Sequence-based Learning Framework
problem: Power-grid (PG) structure design at advanced nodes (3nm, 2nm) is critical for power integrity and performance, but design space exploration is complex; initial PG structures dominate optimization space.
motivation: Shrinking device-to-metal pitch ratios make power-grid integrity increasingly important for performance; efficient exploration of initial PG structures is needed for industrial design flows.
method: Proposes a unified framework combining a novel sequence-based structure generator with a Transformer-based voltage-drop predictor. Learned embeddings from the predictor are used to identify promising PG structure candidates on the Pareto frontier during optimization. The sequence-based generator creates candidate PG topologies, while the Transformer predictor estimates static voltage-drop with high accuracy.
key_novelty: First unified framework combining sequence-based PG structure generation with Transformer-based voltage-drop prediction for industrial power-grid optimization.
contributions: Sequence-based structure generator for PG topology exploration
Transformer-based predictor for static voltage-drop estimation (0.011% max error)
Pareto frontier-guided optimization identifying promising candidates
15% PG utilization reduction with 34% worst timing-slack improvement on 3nm/2nm designs
primary_theme: Sequence-based structure generation with Transformer voltage prediction
